mapper.sql: ers.rule_set_id as "ruleSetId", ers.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", ers.target_scope as "targetScope", ers.rule_set_name as "ruleSetName", ers.rule_set_status as "ruleSetStatus", ers.active_yn as "activeYn", ers.effective_start_date as "effectiveStartDate", ers.effective_end_date as "effectiveEndDate", ers.change_reason as "changeReason", ers.updated_by as "updatedBy", ers.updated_at as "updatedAt"
from evaluation_rule_sets ers inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = ers.rule_version_id

where.if: and (ers.target_scope ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ers.rule_set_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ers.rule_set_status ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_rule_sets (rule_version_id, target_scope, rule_set_name, rule_set_status, active_yn, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.ruleVersionId}, #{request.targetScope}, #{request.ruleSetName}, #{request.ruleSetStatus}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.effectiveStartDate}, #{request.effectiveEndDate}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (rule_version_id, target_scope, rule_set_name, effective_start_date, effective_end_date) do update set rule_set_status = EXCLUDED.rule_set_status, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
